description: User-supplied controller performance targets. Bandwidth is closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth in Hz; margins are lower bounds; time-domain values are upper bounds.

definitions.bandwidth: first closed-loop magnitude crossing at -3.0103 dB relative to the low-frequency closed-loop gain
definitions.gain_margin: minimum classical open-loop gain margin in dB; no phase crossing is treated as infinite and reported with a finite cap
definitions.phase_margin: minimum classical open-loop phase margin in degrees
definitions.overshoot: maximum normalized step-response excursion above the final reference
definitions.settling_time: first time after which the response remains within plus or minus 2 percent of the final reference
